sloka: यदा तु युद्धमाकाङ्क्षन् कश्चिदेनं समाह्वयेत् ।तदा शूलं गहीत्वा तं भस्म रक्षः करोति हि ।। ७.६३.२७ ॥
transliteration: yadā tu yuddhamākāṅkṣan kaścidenaṁ samāhvayet ।tadā śūlaṁ gahītvā taṁ bhasma rakṣaḥ karoti hi ।। 7.63.27 ॥

translations.english: But when someone desiring battle would challenge him, the demon (Madhu) would then take the trident and indeed reduce that challenger to ashes.
